body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q1FY25 call (2024-08-09), volunteered: "we are working on some significant things over there, which hopefully creates -- it gives a third platform for growth soon" Metric: New product platform / acquisition. Target: Third platform launched or acquired. Deadline: 2025-11-30 (vague). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: MISSED. Evidence: No acquisition or third platform by Nov-2026. Q4FY26 call (2026-05-26), when asked: 'We acknowledge that this has been talked about for a long time ... evaluated about a dozen targets since IPO ... close on 2 occasions, and both fell apart.' The Oct-2025 INR 101.6 cr special dividend was 'partly because we ... decided not to proceed'. Management explanation: Two deals fell apart; strict ROE/ROCE-accretive, no-turnaround criteria.
